**6B.6 Research Note: Narendra Modi in 2024**

**Bottom line:** mixed, leaning negative. There is credible evidence of reactive relief and de-escalatory crisis messaging, but stronger counterevidence that avoidable suffering persisted in Manipur, Jammu and Kashmir, and among poor children facing inflation-linked nutrition cuts.

**Accepted claims**

- [The Home Ministry said it was committed to safety for citizens in Manipur and outlined support for food, water, medicine, health, education, and rehabilitation for displaced people](https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2025980&lang=2&reg=48) - Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Home Affairs, 17 Jun 2024. Claim: the government publicly promised a protection-and-relief response for displaced people in Manipur, including force deployment and basic services, which is positive but reactive crisis mitigation. QIDs: 6B.6; 6B.3

- [Modi said India’s approach was “people-centric” and called for dialogue and diplomacy as the way forward in the Russia-Ukraine war](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2015753&lang=2&reg=48) - Prime Minister’s Office / PIB, 20 Mar 2024. Claim: Modi framed the Ukraine crisis around diplomacy rather than escalation, which is relevant as a harm-reduction posture during an active conflict. QIDs: 6B.6; 1B.1; 1B.4

- [Reuters reported Modi used emotive, pro-civilian language to rebuke Putin after the hospital strike in Ukraine](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indias-modi-tells-putin-that-heart-bleeds-when-children-are-killed-3512452) - Reuters via Investing.com, 9 Jul 2024. Claim: Modi publicly emphasized civilian protection in a live war context, which supports a limited reading of avoidable-suffering reduction through diplomacy and moral pressure. QIDs: 6B.6; 1B.1

- [The interim budget centered the poor, women, youth, and farmers while avoiding a classic giveaway](https://theprint.in/india/indias-finance-minister-unveils-budget-with-focus-on-poor-women-youth-and-farmers/1948406/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 1 Feb 2024. Claim: the government claimed a fiscally restrained, distribution-focused budget, which is indirect positive evidence that it was trying to soften economic stress without pure patronage. QIDs: 6B.6; 6B.3; 6B.4

- [HRW said the government stigmatized minorities, Manipur saw deaths and displacement, and the state prolonged internet shutdowns](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/india-increased-abuses-against-minorities-critics) - Human Rights Watch, 11 Jan 2024. Claim: the state failed to prevent or contain serious harm in Manipur, including displacement and service disruption, which is direct counterevidence to crisis harm reduction. QIDs: 6B.6; 6B.3; 6B.8

- [Amnesty said the BJP-led state and central governments failed to end the violence, protect displaced residents, or hold vigilante groups accountable in Manipur](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/india-authorities-missing-in-action-amid-ongoing-violence-and-impunity-in-manipur-state-new-testimonies/) - Amnesty International, 16 Jul 2024. Claim: authorities did not effectively stop the crisis or protect victims, so avoidable suffering persisted despite official relief language. QIDs: 6B.6; 6B.3; 6B.8

- [Reuters reported tear gas, stun grenades, curfews, and internet/mobile shutdowns in Manipur after unrest tied to ethnic violence and security failures](https://theprint.in/india/internet-suspended-in-parts-of-indias-manipur-as-students-clash-with-police/2261451/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 10 Sep 2024. Claim: the response to the Manipur crisis was coercive containment rather than a clearly protective or restorative strategy, which weakens the case for suffering reduction. QIDs: 6B.6; 6B.8

- [Reuters reported school meal budgets had not kept pace with food inflation, forcing cutbacks in nutrition for poor children](https://theprint.in/india/indias-high-food-inflation-leaves-less-in-lunch-boxes-of-poor-school-children/2307077/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 11 Oct 2024. Claim: the government did not fully cushion vulnerable children from an economic shock, and avoidable suffering remained visible in basic nutrition. QIDs: 6B.6; 6B.3; 5B.10

- [HRW said Indian security forces continued arbitrary detention, extrajudicial killings, and other serious abuses in Jammu and Kashmir](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/31/india-repression-persists-jammu-and-kashmir) - Human Rights Watch, 31 Jul 2024. Claim: the state’s coercive security posture in J&K remained a source of avoidable suffering rather than a clear mitigation of crisis harms. QIDs: 6B.6; 6B.8

**Search gap**

- I found solid crisis-related evidence for Manipur, J&K, Ukraine diplomacy, and food-inflation stress, but little independent 2024 evidence on pandemics, famine, or major natural disasters specific to Modi’s decisionmaking.
- The strongest positive items are mostly official relief statements or diplomatic rhetoric; the strongest negative items are independent rights and Reuters reporting on failure, coercion, and unmet household distress.
